program.name: 4-Week Dumbbell HIIT
program.description: 16 low-impact 30-minute mixed cardio and dumbbell HIIT sessions.
notes: Every workout is 5 minutes warm-up, 20 minutes of circuits, and 5 minutes cooldown.
Each 10-minute circuit has 5 exercises with work/rest pairings repeated twice.
Rest interval after the last exercise of each circuit is intentionally included to preserve original 30-minute duration.
Audio countdown cues suggested at 3, 2, 1 seconds, with a longer cue at interval transitions.
Lower-back-friendly emphasis: avoid painful movements, maintain upright posture, and use lighter weights or bodyweight when needed.
